'''FK Rudar Pljevlja''', commonly known as '''Rudar Pljevlja''' or simply '''Rudar''', is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Pljevlja]], [[Montenegro]]. It currently plays in the [[Montenegrin Second League]], the country's second tier.

Rudar have played in the First League since its inception in 2006, and won two league titles in [[2009–10 Montenegrin First League|2009–10]] and [[2014–15 Montenegrin First League|2014–15]]. The club have been the strongest in the [[Montenegrin Cup]], with three triumphs, one runner-up position and two semi-final finishes in the tournament's six seasons.{{citation needed|date= January 2021}}"}}
